question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph presents the total production of a company (in lakh tonnes) over the given years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac3da5a5767d54fa399189b473ec9b17c088757ce7ce2483dceae11808e85e11.png] 

In which year did the company record maximum percentage increase in production as compared to the previous year?
solution:
**Given:**

2013: 65 lakh tonnes

2014: 45 lakh tonnes

2015: 35 lakh tonnes

2016: 55 lakh tonnes

2017: 75 lakh tonnes

2018: 35 lakh tonnes

2019: 90 lakh tonnes

2020: 90 lakh tonnes

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = ((New value - Old value) / Old value) × 100

**Calculation:**

From 2014 to 2015:

⇒ ((35 - 45) / 45) × 100 = -22.22% (decrease)

From 2015 to 2016:

⇒ ((55 - 35) / 35) × 100 = 57.14%

From 2016 to 2017:

⇒ ((75 - 55) / 55) × 100 = 36.36%

From 2017 to 2018:

⇒ ((35 - 75) / 75) × 100 = -53.33% (decrease)

From 2018 to 2019:

⇒ ((90 - 35) / 35) × 100 = 157.14%

From 2019 to 2020:

⇒ ((90 - 90) / 90) × 100 = 0% (no change)

**∴ The maximum percentage increase in production occurred in 2019 with an increase of 157.14%.**
